bullets: Fixed the streak day so it now resets at midnight in your account's own timezone instead of always using Pacific time.
Fixed a stale BYOK connection lock so a custom provider connection interrupted mid-update no longer leaves an unrecoverable lock that blocks future edits.
Updated the /byok help text into a numbered quickstart showing API-key export commands for Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell, plus OpenRouter and Ollama Cloud examples.
Added the /reasoning slash command (also usable as /effort or /think) to open the reasoning-effort picker directly from the chat input.
Updated Solar Mini 4 pricing with its own scheduled changes, including a free weekend window and a return to its regular paid price.
Changed Gravity Index so Freebuff Desktop traffic is tagged with its own surface label instead of being attributed to the CLI version.
Added trust checking for MCP servers that remote agent templates list, so publishers you have not approved are refused if they include external tools or executable code.
